semiconductor_relevance: High — JTEKT Grinding Tools Corporation provides essential grinding and polishing tools for semiconductor fabrication, focusing on compound semiconductor substrates.
summary: JTEKT Grinding Tools Corporation specializes in advanced grinding and polishing tools, including diamond grinding wheels and abrasive materials for CMP, grinding, lapping, and polishing processes. Their products are crucial for the fabrication of high-performance semiconductor devices, particularly those involving compound semiconductor substrates like GaAs on Silicon, GaN, InP, and SiGe.
capabilities: Tools for grinding, lapping, and polishing
